subject.title: feat(ui): approval UX overhaul — inline cards, fair queue, shortcuts, badges

question: Should the broader inline approval, queue, badge, and keyboard-shortcut interaction model be sponsored after the hidden-surface safeguard and live approval-flow proof are supplied?
rationale: This is a large new security-adjacent UX surface rather than a narrowly established bug fix, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human sponsorship of the permanent interaction contract.

options.title: Sponsor after safety proof
options.body: Require the visibility fallback and live redacted approval-flow evidence, then review the complete UX as the intended approval interaction model.

options.title: Narrow to modal queueing
options.body: Keep the oldest-first modal queue and defer inline cards, badges, and shortcuts to a separately sponsored product proposal.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the current approval flow unchanged until a maintainer selects a narrower approval-UX direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after safety proof
recommendation.body: Require the visibility fallback and live redacted approval-flow evidence, then review the complete UX as the intended approval interaction model.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned participant and the recent contributor for this proposed approval interaction model.
